s: Allah curses intentional killing (of a believer)
q: Allah is wroth against him and He hath cursed him and prepared for him an awful doom.

s: believers are to discriminate peace (when going forth to fight in Allah's way)
q: O ye who believe! When ye go forth (to fight) in the way of Allah, be careful to discriminate, and say not unto one who offereth you peace: "Thou art not a believer,"

s: believers are not to call disbelievers (those who offer peace)
q: say not unto one who offereth you peace: "Thou art not a believer,"

s: hypocrites desire disbelief (that believers may be upon a level with them)
q: They long that ye should disbelieve even as they disbelieve, that ye may be upon a level (with them).

s: fighting in Allah's way has rank (above remaining sedentary)
q: Allah hath conferred on those who strive with their wealth and lives a rank above the sedentary

s: fighting in Allah's way involves wealth (of believers who strive)
q: Those of the believers who sit still, other than those who have a (disabling) hurt, are not on an equality with those who strive in the way of Allah with their wealth and lives.

s: fighting in Allah's way involves lives (of believers who strive)
q: Those of the believers who sit still, other than those who have a (disabling) hurt, are not on an equality with those who strive in the way of Allah with their wealth and lives.

s: Allah promises reward (to both those who strive and those who sit still)
q: Unto each Allah hath promised good, but He hath bestowed on those who strive a great reward above the sedentary;

s: fighting in Allah's way has great reward (above the sedentary)
q: but He hath bestowed on those who strive a great reward above the sedentary;

s: angels take in death oppressed people (while they wrong themselves)
q: Lo! as for those whom the angels take (in death) while they wrong themselves

s: earth is spacious (such that migration is possible)
q: Was not Allah's earth spacious that ye could have migrated therein?

s: oppressed people have as habitation Hell (when they could have migrated but did not)
q: As for such, their habitation will be hell, an evil journey's end;

s: men may be feeble (and unable to devise a plan or find a way)
q: Except the feeble among men, and the women, and the children, who are unable to devise a plan and are not shown a way.

s: Allah sends astray hypocrites
q: Seek ye to guide him whom Allah hath sent astray? He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him thou (O MUhammad) canst not find a road.

s: women may be feeble (and unable to devise a plan or find a way)
q: Except the feeble among men, and the women, and the children, who are unable to devise a plan and are not shown a way.

s: children may be feeble (and unable to devise a plan or find a way)
q: Except the feeble among men, and the women, and the children, who are unable to devise a plan and are not shown a way.

s: Allah may pardon oppressed people (the feeble, women, and children unable to devise a plan or find a way)
q: As for such, it may be that Allah will pardon them. Allah is ever Clement, Forgiving.

s: migration provides refuge (for one who migrates for Allah's cause)
q: Whoso migrateth for the cause of Allah will find much refuge and abundance in the earth

s: migration provides abundance (in the earth)
q: Whoso migrateth for the cause of Allah will find much refuge and abundance in the earth

s: Allah rewards migration (when death overtakes the migrant who forsakes home for Allah and His messenger)
q: and whoso forsaketh his home, a fugitive unto Allah and His messenger, and death overtaketh him, his reward is then incumbent on Allah.

s: migration is for Allah (when undertaken for His cause)
q: Whoso migrateth for the cause of Allah will find much refuge and abundance in the earth

s: hell as an eternal punishment is Hell (for the intentional killer of a believer, forever)
q: Whoso slayeth a believer of set purpose, his reward is hell for ever.

s: Allah is a forgiving
q: Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

s: Allah is a merciful
q: Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

s: people with whom there is a covenant are not to be waged war against fighting (when they hold aloof, do not wage war, and offer peace)
q: So, if they hold aloof from you and wage not war against you and offer you peace, Allah alloweth you no way against them.

s: believers are prohibited from intentional killing (of another believer)
q: It is not for a believer to kill a believer unless (it be) by mistake.

l: The Opening (Al-Faatiha), The Opening (Al-Faatiha), Surah 1: The Opening (Al-Faatiha)
s: Surah 1: The Opening (Al-Faatiha) is revealed at Mecca and concerns worship, praise, and seeking guidance from Allah. Allah is praised as the Lord of the Worlds and as Beneficent and Merciful. The text identifies the Day of Judgment and asks for guidance to the straight path. It distinguishes those who receive favor from those who earn anger or go astray.

l: Surah 1: The Opening (Al-Faatiha), The Opening (Al-Faatiha), Surah 1: The Opening (Al-Faatiha)
s: Surah 1: The Opening (Al-Faatiha) is revealed at Mecca. It praises Allah, identifies Him as Beneficent and Merciful, declares worship of Him, and asks Him for help and guidance.

l: Allah, The Opening (Al-Faatiha), Surah 1: The Opening (Al-Faatiha)
s: Allah is praised as the Lord of the Worlds, the Beneficent, and the Merciful. He alone is worshipped and asked for help, and He is asked to show the straight path.
